nodes.title: Mentaury-Kernel — Architecture
nodes.summary: Technology-neutral cross-domain composition architecture defining provenance, authority, loss, receipts, continuity and admission boundaries.
nodes.why_read: Open for the composition mission and ownership test: what must survive when meaning crosses independently governed domains.

nodes.title: Mentaury-Kernel — Composition Invariants
nodes.summary: Current composition-level invariant taxonomy: provenance conservation, authority non-escalation, explicit loss, admission isolation, branch/currentness and receipt boundaries.
nodes.why_read: Open when a cross-domain rule is proposed; first test whether an existing invariant already covers the failure.

nodes.title: Mentaury-Kernel — Normative Provenance Matrix
nodes.summary: Normative provenance matrix recording origin, source status, local composition status, scope, rationale and reconciliation triggers for inherited and local rules.
nodes.why_read: Open to verify where a composition invariant came from and whether a source change actually requires semantic reconciliation.

nodes.title: Mentaury-Kernel — Threat Model
nodes.summary: Cross-domain semantic threat model for authority escalation, provenance laundering, silent loss, stale receipts/currentness and identity/consent boundary failures.
nodes.why_read: Open when evaluating how a cross-domain integration could corrupt provenance, scope, authority, loss, continuity or admission meaning.

nodes.title: Mentaury-Kernel — Conformance Scenarios
nodes.summary: Bounded scenarios used to challenge the composition specification without turning scenario success into production or authority approval.
nodes.why_read: Open to test composition invariants against concrete transfers, receipts, forks, restore/migration and authority-boundary cases.

nodes.title: Mentaury-Kernel — Audit & Future Work
nodes.summary: Historical/current future-work and audit ledger that preserves unresolved composition questions but does not select work or authorize implementation.
nodes.why_read: Open after CURRENT_STATUS when tracing why a composition question remains open or what evidence would justify reopening it.

nodes.title: Continuum — AI Entry Point
nodes.summary: Deterministic AI reading-order and authority-routing contract for current state, formal protocol, evidence, human review and external records.
nodes.why_read: Open first for an AI-driven Continuum review so live GitHub, machine state, protocol, evidence and historical ledgers are read in the correct order.

nodes.title: Continuum — Audit & Future Work
nodes.summary: Historical audit and future-work ledger; useful for reopen triggers and dependency history, not a current milestone selector.
nodes.why_read: Open after machine/current state to reconstruct unresolved questions and audit history without treating historical checkpoint fields as current truth.

nodes.title: Continuum — Experiment 0 Preregistration
nodes.summary: Formal Experiment 0 protocol defining bounded capture/transfer isolation semantics and evaluation discipline before evidence collection.
nodes.why_read: Open for what Experiment 0 is allowed to test and how; preregistration itself is not evidence that the hypotheses passed.

nodes.title: Continuum — Human Reference Approval v0.2
nodes.summary: Versioned approval record binding human review provenance to exact candidate bytes and closing only the human-reference dependency.
nodes.why_read: Open when verifying whether the canonical human-reference gate was satisfied; do not infer Pilot or Evidence authorization from approval.

nodes.title: Continuum — Approved Capture Gold v0.1
nodes.summary: Human-approved canonical Experiment 0 capture reference materialized separately from AI-proposed draft candidates.
nodes.why_read: Open for the approved capture-side human reference used by Experiment 0; approval scope does not extend to Pilot/runtime.

nodes.title: Continuum — Approved Transfer Oracle v0.1
nodes.summary: Human-approved canonical Experiment 0 transfer oracle materialized separately from AI-proposed draft candidates.
nodes.why_read: Open for the approved transfer-side human reference used by Experiment 0; oracle approval is not runtime or production authority.

nodes.title: CLOS — Ecosystem Crosswalk
nodes.summary: Research ownership map routing validated CLOS consequences to existing project owners without making CLOS a new ecosystem apex.
nodes.why_read: Open when a CLOS result appears relevant to Crystal, Titan, Native Kernel, Soul, Continuum or Mentaury-Kernel and ownership must be decided explicitly.

nodes.title: CLOS — Reach / Use Measurement
nodes.summary: Research measurement surface decomposing memory/evidence flow into retrieved, serialized, transmitted, used and answer-supporting stages.
nodes.why_read: Open when investigating whether retrieved material merely reached a path or was actually transmitted, used, or answer-supporting.

nodes.title: CLOS — F2 Post-#436 Checkpoint
nodes.summary: Bounded research checkpoint after Titan later-task reopen planning/execution capability: capability established, real query/answer-path use and durable recovery not established.
nodes.why_read: Open for the exact evidence ceiling after the F2/Titan sequence so reopen capability is not confused with policy, semantic use, or answer support.

nodes.title: CLOS — F3 Same Stop / Different Reason
nodes.summary: Bounded evidence that identical outward non-continuation can preserve materially different stop bases and release conditions without a universal STOP ontology.
nodes.why_read: Open when reasoning about stop semantics: same visible STOP does not imply same material basis, but no new universal primitive was justified.

nodes.title: CLOS — Athene Source Manifest
nodes.summary: Provenance manifest for the external Athene research material used in bounded CLOS comparison/crosswalk work.
nodes.why_read: Open before using Athene-derived claims so external-source provenance and source scope remain explicit.

nodes.title: CLOS — Athene Theory-of-Everything Crosswalk
nodes.summary: Comparative research crosswalk mapping Athene material into Velantrim/CLOS questions without promoting donor claims into architecture by origin.
nodes.why_read: Open for bounded comparative mapping of Athene ideas to existing Velantrim concepts and gaps; donor similarity is not evidence or adoption.
